prototype: Aluminum cantilever teaching rig with movable load hanger and dial gauge
checklist_source: Rig builders' published procedure, section 5, figure 7 and table 2, https://peer.asee.org/effective-use-of-an-undergraduate-research-fellowship-for-design-and-manufacture-of-tools-to-assist-in-teaching-strength-of-materials.pdf

conditions.description: Hang the nominal test weight at B (half span) and read displacement at C (the free end).
Use the same weight at C, move the gauge to B and compare that reading with the first. Comparing two tip readings does not establish reciprocity.
Keep the dial probe perpendicular to the beam and on its longitudinal centerline at each gauge position.
Set the gauge bracket to give approximately 1 mm of initial probe compression.
